name: Cecille
source:
Karen's sister and pupil of the Academy, she is the Student Council president. Obedient, quiet and calm person she is often regarded as opposite of her more outspoken sister, her innocence and soft personality come from always being under her shadow.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=422446&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
